√śrath 'slacken'
present: [9.] áśrathnan śrathnās śrathnīté etc. -- śṛnthati -- [1.] śrathati śranthate ślathati ślathate etc. 
perfect: śaśrathe śaśrantha 
aorist: [3.] śiśráthat etc. śiśrathantu -- [5.] aśranthīt aśranthiṣṭa 
[future: śranthisyati śranthitā ]
verbal: śṛthitá ślathita śrathitvā śranthitvā -śrathya 
secondary: causative: śratháyati etc. śratháyate ślathayati ślathyate śrāthayati śranthayati 
derivatives: śratha- śrathar- RV. ślatha E.+

√śran 'give'
[present: śraṇati etc. ]
secondary: causative: śrāṇayati etc. S.+ aśiśraṇat aśaśrāṇat śraṇayati 
derivatives: -śrāṇana -śrāṇika C. 
Only with prefix vi.

√śram 'be weary'
present: [4.] śrā́myati etc. V.+ -- [1.] śramati śramate etc. E.+ 
perfect: śaśrāma śaśramus V.+ śremus śaśramāṇá 
aorist: [1.] aśrami aśrāmi -- [2.] áśramat etc. -- [5.] śramiṣma 
future: [1.] śramiṣyati -- [2.] śramitā 
verbal: śrāṃtá V.+ -śrámya B.+ 
secondary: passive: śramyate E.+ -- desiderative: śiśramiṣa- -- causative: śramayati etc. S.+ śrāmayati etc. E.+ śrāmyate E.+ 
derivatives: śráma V.+ -śrāma E.+ śramaṇá B.+ -śramaṇa V.+ śrāṃti E.+ -śramiṣṭha RV. -śiśramiṣu C.

√śrambh 'trust'
present: [1.] śrambhate etc. E.+ 
[perfect: śaśrambhe aśrabhat aśrambhiṣṭa śrambhiṣyate śrambhitā ]
verbal: śrabdha E.+ -śrabhya 
secondary: causative: śrambhayati etc. S.+ 
derivatives: -śṛmbhá -śrambha E.+ -śrambin C. -śrambhana C. -śrambhanīya C. -śrabdhi C.

√śrā 'boil'
present: śrā́yati etc. -- [9.] śrīṇā́ti etc. -- [2.] śrāti 
[perfect: śaśrau śrāyāt śreyāt aśrāsīt śrāsyati śrātā ]
verbal: śrātá śṛtá V.+ śrāṇa 
secondary: intensive: śāśrā- -- desiderative: śiśrāsa- -- causative: śrapáyati etc. AV.+ śrapáyate etc. aśiśrapat etc. śrapyáte etc. B.+ 
derivatives: śīrá? śáras? B. -śrápa B. śrāpin S. śrápaṇa B.+ śrapayitṛ́ B.

√sraṅs 'fall'
present: [1.] sráṅsate etc. B.+ sráṅsati etc. E.+ 
perfect: sasraṅsus sraṅsire? 
perfect: [1.] asrat -- [2.] asrasat etc. V.+ srasema -- [3.] asisrasat etc. -- [5.] asraṅsiṣata 
[future: sraṅsiṣyate sraṅsitā ]
verbal: srasta AV.+ sraṅsitvā srastvā -sráṅsya -srasya -srásas passive: srasyate -- intensive: sanisras- -- desiderative: sisraṅsiṣa- -- causative: sraṅsayati etc. AV.+ sraṅsyate 
derivatives: -sras -srásā B.S. -srásya B. sraṅsa AV.+ -sráṅsaka B. sraṅsin C. sraṅsana E.+ sanisrasá AV.
